context.content: Thank you so much! I actually did make a business out of this hobby last year after friends and coworkers kept encouraging it. I originally started out making game piece upgrades for my board games (think like custom designed characters instead of wooden vaguely human-shaped pieces), and then decided to start making fan art for video games as well. Honestly it has been the most satisfying work I've ever done in my life. As long as I can afford to keep doing it, I will never want to do anything else. Traditional jobs don't really have a place for people who like tedious detail-oriented solo stuff, but it works for this hobby and that makes me insanely happy. You can search for my username on Etsy if you'd like to check out what I've done. Not everything I've ever made is there (if you want to see everything, I post it all on instagram @MadeByMoin so that I can look back and see my progress over time)
